page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number 89 at right; one text column in the centre; a faint marginal note at the right margin ("Ephesi." area) and a faint note at lower right; catchword "abso-" at the foot right below the last line.

main_text.p: itiniæ vita æterna, sed donum Dei vita æterna ; vt intelliga-mus non ex nostris meritis, sed ex gratuito Dei dono, asse-qui nos pro fine vitam æter-nam: propter quod & subdit, In Christo Iesu Domino no-stro : Ecce meritum, ecce iusti-tiam, cuius stipendium est vi-ta æterna, nobis autem do-num, ratione ipsius Iesu Chri-sti. Hæc Caietanus : Quid planius vel Lutherus, vel Cal-uinus, vel quis alius Euangeli-corum? Quàm imperfecta in nobis, & munera Dei & no-stra opera clamitat vbiq; Scri-ptura ? Et sunto quidem illa gratiæ munera suis numeris

page.notes: The first line is partly worn ("itiniæ" may read "lustitiæ"; the word before "vita" is uncertain). The marginal notes at right are faint and largely illegible; the lower right note is read only approximately. The text is read from a faint scan; the reading "Ephesi." is doubtful.
